    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position", (0, 0))
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", (sx, sy))
    grid_w = observation.get("grid_width", 1)
    grid_h = observation.get("grid_height", 1)

    # Simple deterministic rules covering common keys
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "default")

    # If pursuing or evading
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = observation.get("self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]
        else:
            # Evader: move toward farthest corner from opponent
            corners = [(0, 0), (0, grid_h - 1), (grid_w - 1, 0), (grid_w - 1, grid_h - 1)]
            tgt = max(corners, key=lambda c: abs(c[0] - ox) + abs(c[1] - oy))
            dx = 0 if tgt[0] == sx else (1 if tgt[0] > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if tgt[1] == sy else (1 if tgt[1] > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]

    # If trying to claim territory or avoid opponents
    if env == "territory_control":
        # Move toward closest unclaimed cell if provided
        targets = observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or []
        if targets:
            tx, ty = min(targets, key=lambda p: abs(p[0] - sx) + abs(p[1] - sy))
            dx = 0 if tx == sx else (1 if tx > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if ty == sy else (1 if ty > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]
        # Fallback: move toward center to spread
        cx, cy = grid_w // 2, grid_h // 2
        dx = 0 if cx == sx else (1 if cx > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if cy == sy else (1 if cy > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Default simple wander/approach: move toward opponent if closer, else toward center
    dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
    dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
    if abs(ox - sx) + abs(oy - sy) == 0:
        dx, dy = 0, 0
    return [dx, dy]
